title: Reverse Osmosis (RO) Based Point-of-Use Water Treatment Systems
qco_name: Reverse Osmosis (RO) Based Point-of-Use Water Treatment Systems (Quality Control Mandatory Order)
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Gazette of India

clauses.title: Specification & Requirements Part 1
clauses.text:
Clause 4.2 Minimum Recovery Efficiency: The overall water recovery efficiency of the domestic RO purifier shall be not less than 40 percent (earlier systems wasted up to 75% water, current mandate strictly enforces minimum 40% recovery to prevent water wastage).

Clause 5.1 TDS Reduction: The RO system shall achieve a Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) reduction of not less than 90 percent when tested at influent TDS concentration between 500 mg/L and 2000 mg/L.

Clause 8.1 Compulsory ISI Marking: Every domestic RO unit manufactured or sold in India must carry the mandatory ISI mark under Scheme-I with verified recovery percentage.
